work.title: Untitled (Studio Desk View) 2
work.description: Studio desk surface holds framed photographs, compact discs, small artworks, and a tape dispenser beneath a glowing Busch On Tap neon sign. Copper pendant lamp hangs at upper left; cinder-block walls and exposed ceiling joists frame the workspace.
